# Luckify ✨ Virtual Lucky Garden & Fortune Oracle

Luckify is a beautiful, highly interactive virtual lucky garden, decision-making tool, and fortune-telling suite designed with custom animations, Canvas-based physics simulations, and a sleep dark aesthetic.

It is 100% free, open-source, requires no user registration, no advertisements, and runs entirely in the browser.

## Core Capabilities

- **Decision Making**: Custom segment prize wheels and yes-or-no dowsing pendulums.
- **Classic Simulators**: 3D dice rollers and lottery ball drawer stats.
- **Divination & Blessings**: Traditional Chinese Hongbao envelopes, 3D paper cootie catchers, Magic 8-Ball spheres, and bottled ocean messages.

---

## Active Game Directory

### 1. [Lobby Home (Lobby Page)](https://luckify.vercel.app/)
- **Description**: The main dashboard listing all games with interactive cards and showing the user's aggregate play session history.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/`

### 2. [Fortune Wheel](https://luckify.vercel.app/wheel)
- **Description**: Customizable prize wheel spinner using Canvas. Edit wedges, segment titles, and colors.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/wheel`

### 3. [Lucky Dice](https://luckify.vercel.app/dice)
- **Description**: Interactive 3D CSS dice rolling arena. Roll up to 3 dice with custom scoring targets and clattering audio.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/dice`

### 4. [Number Picker](https://luckify.vercel.app/picker)
- **Description**: Staggered Powerball lottery ball drawer drawing 6 numbers out of 49. Builds a dynamic SVG draw frequency chart.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/picker`

### 5. [Pendulum Divination](https://luckify.vercel.app/pendulum)
- **Description**: HTML5 Canvas physics-based dowsing pendulum oracle. Input a yes/no query and release the silver bob wire.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/pendulum`

### 6. [Lucky Envelope](https://luckify.vercel.app/lucky-envelope)
- **Description**: Chinese red packet (Hongbao) simulation featuring pure CSS 3D envelope unfolding. Reveals a positive cultural blessing and lucky number.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/lucky-envelope`

### 7. [Origami Fortune](https://luckify.vercel.app/fortune-teller)
- **Description**: Interactive 3D paper cootie catcher game. Choose colors and numbers, and watch the folding pinching transitions before lifting a flap.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/fortune-teller`

### 8. [Magic 8-Ball](https://luckify.vercel.app/magic-8-ball)
- **Description**: 3D shaking gloss-black Magic 8-Ball oracle. Ask any query and reveal floating triangular replies.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/magic-8-ball`

### 9. [Message in a Bottle](https://luckify.vercel.app/message-in-bottle)
- **Description**: Ocean bottle mail simulator. Retrieve a bobbing glass bottle from parallax sea waves, pop the cork, and unfurl scroll affirmations.
- **URL**: `https://luckify.vercel.app/message-in-bottle`
